name: Mailchimp Popup Block
description: provides a configurable block that opens a Mailchimp subscriber pop-up, either manually via a button or automatically on page load.
project_description:
Update 07/2023 : Unfortunately Mailchimp does not provide the necessary popup configuration values anymore. This means the module is getting deprecated and only existing configurations are maintained by the module from now on. 
 
 
 
 The Mailchimp Popup Block module provides a block with a button, that triggers the opening of the Subscriber pop-up .

 GDPR ready 
 The Mailchimp API and therefore the Mailchimp module currently do not provide an implementation for the Mailchimp's GDPR feature. For that reason it should not be used for websites with an EU audience anymore, unless your users give their consent in a different way. 

 According to the Mailchimp knowledge base , the Subscriber pop-up form is the only supported GDPR compliant embedding option (August 2018).

 This module provides an integration for this pop-up, which is triggered by clicking on a specific element. It comes with completely unstyled markup to make it easy to integrate with your theme.
